title: Impressions Of The Shield Hero [Part 2]
paragraphs: “Come to think of it, big sister Larsa also quietly teams up with my brother from time to time, huh?”
“W-Why the hell am I the one getting knocked up by the Shield Hero!?”

Yeah, that’s right. The panda from Motoyasu’s story… came to visit the village shortly before Motoyasu started including her in his tales. Apparently, she’s an old acquaintance of Sadeena’s from their days in Zeltoble, and she even joined the final battle against the trash goddess. Even after peace returned to the world, she continued working as a mercenary, but decided to stop by our village to see her former comrades like Sadeena. She brought her subordinates along too. Anyway, she got into it with Keel for wearing that ridiculous outfit… like a maid uniform. But with how blatantly she acted, there’s no way people wouldn’t assume something was going on. As a gag, she was called a mascot panda and hired to help sell goods with Keel. She pretended to be annoyed, but even after the agreed time passed, she never quit. Now, she’s part of a team with Keel and moves around with him.
“Big sister Larsa! In moments like this, you gotta strike a pose like you’re super embarrassed!”
Keel’s totally hooked on theater now, so he’s gotten used to cross-dressing and striking poses without hesitation.
“L-Like this?”
“Yeah, and the line is: ‘N-No! Why am I the one getting knocked up!?’”
That’s not the kind of thing you can just fix by changing how you say it. Seriously, Keel… do you even know what you’re saying? If you do, then it’s time for a lecture.
“What the hell!? Don’t mess with me!”
“Keel-kun, let’s report where you learned that line to Naofumi later, okay?”
“Wait, seriously? Is this where I get in trouble!?”
Nice deduction. Seriously though, who told you that? My bet is on Sadeena or someone connected to the slave trader.
“Pii!”

Oh yeah, Motoyasu also named that Filolial Luna or something. It’s always riding on Keel’s head, cheerfully posing nonstop. Apparently its coloring is a bit different though. It’s also close with Imiya, and kind of functions as the personal Filolial for Imiya, Keel, and the panda. They’re one of the top-selling groups in the village, with Keel at the center.
“Sasa-chan.”
Without anyone noticing, Sadeena suddenly moved behind the panda and locked her in a full-body hold.
“Why don’t you have some fun with Naofumi-chan and big sister? Like Big Sisters in Motoyasu-chan’s story.”
“Eeek!? S-Stop… I…”
“Big sister knows~ Sasa-chan has a tiny crush on Naofumi-chan, ever since he introduced you to work.”
“That’s wro—ng…”
Ugh… she’s contaminated too. She’s made no real contributions, but she’s the same type as Sadeena. She might try to gang up on me. I should definitely increase my caution level.
“Are you not listening to my story? This is the continuation about the Filolials.”
“Say whatever you want.”
“Then, next up.”
And so, Motoyasu began talking about the current state of the Filolials. Though apparently, most of them are ones we already know, with very few differences.
“Now then, it’s Kuro-chan.”
“I know that one. The wild Filolial that took a liking to Ren, right?”
“Ugh…”
Ren, who had been quietly observing, choked on his words. Next to him stood a humanoid Filolial, about the size of a middle schooler, clad in black clothing.
“Hm? Do you need something from the great Black Thunder-sama?”

Originally, it was a request that came under Fitoria’s name, saying there was a Filolial at a certain ranch with an uncontrollably violent temperament. But when the job was handed off to Motoyasu, for some reason he called in Ren to deal with it, and it ended up bonding with him and following him back. Apparently, it liked something about the atmosphere Ren gave off or whatever.

Well, before that, Filo had already beaten the crap out of it, but even after that, it didn’t stop acting violently and kept spouting weird chuunibyou-style lines and womanizing remarks. It tried to pounce on Filo while calling her a fine woman and got utterly thrashed. They were considering whether to get rid of it when the issue was resolved quickly. I was impressed by Motoyasu’s handling, but now I get it from hearing this.
“Come now, Ren. Let’s dye the world in darkness and build a harem together.”
“Sorry, but I’ll pass. I’ve outgrown that sort of thing.”
“Fufufu… Even if you refuse, the black faith at the core of your being—Black Piety—won’t vanish. Your fall is only a matter of time.”
“Give me a break…”
So yeah, Ren’s clearly troubled by being pushed on like this. Seems like it’d be a problem to even sell her off, so he’s stuck with her. Well, looks like Ren’s gotten somewhat used to it lately.
“Exactly. Kuro-chan has grown a bit. Just like Ren.”

Ren’s shameful history keeps expanding… I can sympathize. Also, come to think of it—Ren and Itsuki act really different in Motoyasu’s stories compared to how they are now. Ren’s practically overly serious and devoted, while Itsuki’s… kind of the quiet type. At their core, Ren’s a chuunibyou and Itsuki’s a sharp-tongued brat. …Well, sometimes you see glimpses of it, but who knows.
“I suppose such a world might exist.”
“A world where Itsuki-sama saved me.”
“Though sometimes it’s already too late…”
“Even then, he still tries to save them, doesn’t he?”
“Rishia-san…”
“Itsuki-sama…”
Yeah, yeah. Enough with the sweet mood. Save it for when you get home. In fact, just go home now.
“Well then, that about sums up the Filolials’ status. Any questions?”
Motoyasu kept talking like that, but the small talk continued, ignoring him entirely. Nobody seemed interested in asking him anything.
“Well, nothing’s really wrong, I guess. So? Is this a record of Gaelion’s love for Naofumi?”
“Shut up! Get out of the village already!”
Right. And among all these problems, this one takes up a lot of space. Formally, I should call it Female Gaelion? Let’s just go with Meslion.
She’s settled into the village. As for how that happened, it started during that whole rotten Valentine’s incident when the chocolate monster went on a rampage.
“Fufufu! Gaelion has finally found a promising vessel!”
While we were fighting in Zeltoble, this thing separated from the wriggling chocolate and lunged at me. It looked like a chocolate dragon.
“Uwah!”
“To think it would appear here… I won’t allow it! Brynhildr X!”
“Really now, Spear Hero, you go all out—”

Motoyasu blew away the chocolate dragon that lunged at me. I didn’t know what it was either at the time, so I just let it go… Its scattered body reassembled itself, escaped into Zeltoble’s underground waterways, gathered strength, and reappeared some time later. Then it had a tearful reunion with Taniko… which was fine up to that point. But after that, it started fighting with the male Gaelion over the core stone.
“Hmph, Gaelion may be female now. But you’re male, and that gender wall you can’t cross is what makes Naofumi an impregnable fortress!”
“Kyuuaaaaahhhh!”

Honestly, neither of them stands a chance. I wish they’d just destroy each other and disappear. That said, the male Gaelion, who had gathered most of the Dragon Emperor fragments, defeated her. She disappeared for a while after that, but recently came back to the village. Apparently, she scavenged some fragments from the Dragon Emperor in Glass and the others’ world.

Well, that homo dragon, you know… The real issue is that Taniko and the homo dragon aren’t in the village right now. If they were, I could dump this mess on them. After Taniko appeared in Motoyasu’s story, she realized the male Gaelion had her father inside him, and at that point, he vanished. Taniko went chasing after him. Occasionally she comes back to the village and chats with Ren and Rat, though. Apparently, Ren is also helping search for Gaelion.

As for what the male Gaelion is doing—it’s partially to escape from Taniko, but also because he heard a legend about a gender-changing potion and is now looking for it. Does he really think I’ll respond just because he becomes female? Dragons really are stupid. Filolials are the same, though.
“Gaelion will endure until a new body is ready. Big sister will capture him and make him have children with a mixed breed of Raf and Filolial.”

And as things are now, she can’t win me over… and seriously, stop with the chocolate body. How long are you going to possess that limited-time monster’s body? I’ve gone off-topic. Meslion is apparently waiting for a new body to inhabit. To that end, she’s aiming to use male Gaelion’s child and plans to pair him up with a Raf species. She’s casually doing something totally unethical.
“Naofumi, just wait. Gaelion will become like that Raf-like creature and be your partner.”
…Has she completely thrown away dragon pride and dignity? Motoyasu really brought a ridiculous one into this world. I figure a class-up would probably trigger the mutation quicker, but… whatever.
“You really think I’d go along with that? Cut it out already, you damn chocolate!”
“Naofumi’s kindness is nice, but I like wild Naofumi too—insult me more!”
“Shut up…”
Feeding attention-seekers never ends well. And with that chocolate monster’s body, she won’t even die if I kill her. She’s trouble no matter what.
